newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-COFFEE SEEN HOLDING IN RANGE, BUILDS BASE.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-COFFEE SEEN HOLDING IN RANGE, BUILDS BASE.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Robusta coffee futures should meander range-bound for the time being, although key September looks to be building a base in preparation for a push higher, technical analysts said on Monday.

Although September has picked itself up from its slump to $1,477 last month, the London market has since traded a series of sessions where the overall price trend has been gently rising but ranges have been tight.
Technical analysts said prices also faced resistance in the form of the trading band between mid-June and mid-July, approximately from $1,700 to $1,900.
"We've seen the lows for the time being but there's not much upside potential," said Darren Gurner, an analyst at Sucden.
September has been hovering between its 10-day and 20-day moving averages for the last two sessions, in tight ranges of $36 and $43.
Traders called the London market to open a notional $35 higher than Friday's close, based on the performance in New York.
Opening calls for London were becoming increasingly untrustworthy as the two markets were behaving independently of each other, they said.
Short-term momentum indicators have been flat and around the neutral zero level for a number of sessions.
"The market is pretty boring," said Gurner, adding that September appeared to be building a base before a push higher.

In fundamental news, Brazil's coffee regions saw cool temperatures over the weekend but no damaging cold. According to local meteorologists Somar, temperatures are expected to pick up over the coming days.
